parse_openfiber_pdf id_servizio regex `\b(AAA\d{4,})\b` will match any AAA-prefixed token anywhere in the PDF (including inside longer words if word boundary allows) — consider anchoring to a labeled prefix like 'ID SERVIZIO' for fewer false positives.

phone regex accepts any 6+ char digit-like sequence after 'Telefono/Recapito/Cellulare/Tel.' — could capture numeric OLO IDs, fiscal codes, etc. that follow these words. Consider whitelisting only lines beginning with the label.
return_to_warehouse: unassigned event 'reason' stored inside 'extra' dict — ensure history GET endpoint preserves that field (this test did not fail but relied on optional history endpoint).

Notification `notify_magazzino` is broadcast to all admin/magazzino users — no de-dup key, so multiple rapid returns of the same serial produce N identical notifications. Consider dedup on (kind, serial, user_id, minute).
